name: B2B Stack

sources.title: 'Cadastre uma solução' product-registration page — renders login wall requiring LinkedIn or Google OAuth

requirements: Account required — registration is OAuth-only: 'Registre-se com LinkedIn' or 'Registre-se com Google' (no email form visible)
Brazilian B2B software review/comparison platform (G2-style); product must be a B2B software/SaaS
Portuguese-language site; huge category taxonomy (ERP, marketing, vendas, RH, etc.) — pick the right one
preparation: A LinkedIn or Google account you can OAuth with
Product name, website, description (Portuguese preferred for fit), logo
Company details — vendor portal lives at stack-manager.b2bstack.com.br
workflow: Register/sign in via LinkedIn or Google OAuth
Fill the product form: name, URL, category, description
Submit for review — listing becomes a product page eligible for user reviews
Vendors can manage the listing via stack-manager.b2bstack.com.br (separate 'Vender' portal)
watchFor: Entirely Brazilian-market focused — an English-only SaaS may be a weak fit but not rejected
OAuth-only signup; no standalone email registration seen
Vendor/seller features at stack-manager.b2bstack.com.br likely push paid lead-gen plans — the free listing exists alongside
Contact route for the listing team is a Google Form
countsAsLive: The product has a public page on b2bstack.com.br under its category, open to reviews and comparison listings
unknowns: Review/approval turnaround for new product submissions
Dofollow status of the product website link
What paid vendor plans cost and whether they gate the listing
